root_cause.text: The powerpc kexec subsystem fails to bring offline CPUs online during reboot when SMT is disabled or partially enabled because `add_cpu()` is blocked by `cpu_bootable()` checks on non-primary or SMT-disallowed threads.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds `kexec_smt_reenable()` to set `cpu_smt_control = CPU_SMT_ENABLED` and `cpu_smt_num_threads = threads_per_core` before calling `wake_offline_cpus()`, preventing `add_cpu()` from failing due to `cpu_bootable()` returning false.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: The powerpc kexec subsystem fails to bring offline CPUs online during reboot when SMT is disabled or partially enabled because `add_cpu()` is blocked by `cpu_bootable()` checks on non-primary or SMT-disallowed threads.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch diff adds `kexec_smt_reenable()` to set `cpu_smt_control = CPU_SMT_ENABLED` and `cpu_smt_num_threads = threads_per_core` before calling `wake_offline_cpus()`, preventing `add_cpu()` from failing due to `cpu_bootable()` returning false.

intent_record.intent_summary: Re-enable SMT during kexec preparation to ensure all offline CPUs can be successfully brought online.
intent_record.what: Added the `kexec_smt_reenable` helper function to re-enable SMT and configure the thread count under hotplug protection.
intent_record.how: This function prevents CPU boot failures during kexec by ensuring SMT is active so that secondary threads pass bootable checks.

intent_record.intent_summary: Re-enable SMT before waking offline CPUs during kexec to ensure all processor threads are properly activated.
intent_record.what: Added a call to kexec_smt_reenable() at the beginning of the wake_offline_cpus function.
intent_record.how: This ensures that Simultaneous Multithreading (SMT) is re-enabled before the system attempts to wake up offline CPUs during a kexec operation.

grouping_result.intent: Re-enable SMT before waking offline CPUs during kexec to ensure all processor threads are properly activated.

consistency_review.core_intent: Re-enable SMT during kexec to ensure all offline CPUs and processor threads can be successfully brought online.

relevance_review.reason: The group's changes directly address the vulnerability by re-enabling SMT during kexec, which allows offline CPUs and SMT threads to be successfully brought online, bypassing the blocking checks described in the root cause.

candidates.rationale: The loop attempts to bring all offline present CPUs online during kexec preparation, but without first re-enabling SMT, the subsequent activation of non-primary or SMT-disallowed threads will be blocked by cpu_bootable() checks.
This condition identifies offline CPUs to bring online, but because SMT is not re-enabled beforehand, attempting to bring these offline SMT threads online will fail.

vuln_statements.explanation: This loop iterates over all present CPUs to bring them online during kexec, but it does so before SMT is re-enabled, causing cpu_bootable() checks to block non-primary threads.
This condition attempts to bring offline CPUs online, but because SMT is not yet re-enabled, the activation of offline SMT threads will fail due to cpu_bootable() checks.
